name: Etereo Kanai , Auberge Collection
insider_take: This architectural marvel sits on sacred Mayan land where ancient cenotes meet the Caribbean Sea, creating a mystical energy that transforms every moment into something transcendent.
whats_special: Etereo seamlessly blends into the natural landscape with its striking concrete and wood design that seems to emerge from the jungle itself. The property sits atop a network of underground cenotes - sacred freshwater pools that the ancient Maya believed were gateways to the underworld. Each suite features floor-to-ceiling windows that dissolve the boundary between indoor and outdoor living, while the infinity pool appears to spill directly into the turquoise Caribbean.
pro_tip: Book a cenote ceremony at sunrise - the hotel's shaman will guide you through an ancient Mayan purification ritual in the underground sacred pool, an experience available nowhere else in the Riviera Maya.
dont_miss: The rooftop observatory where you can stargaze through professional telescopes while learning about Mayan astronomy, and the underground cenote accessible only to hotel guests - a crystal-clear natural pool perfect for meditation and spiritual reflection beneath dramatic stalactites.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Kanai coastline
Sophisticated contemporary design with local Mexican influences
Exceptional culinary experiences with locally-sourced ingredients
cons: Remote location requires transportation for local exploration
